correctness.rationale: With input g_1=G!=0 and g_t=0 afterwards, the source LaProp bias-corrected n_1 yields G/(|G|+ε), and m_t=(1-μ)μ^(t-1) times it. Dividing by 1-μ^t and summing gives K(μ). For t>=2 each term μ^(t-1)/(1+...+μ^(t-1)) increases strictly in μ>0; domination by μ^(t-1) proves convergence for μ<1; fixed partial sums tend to harmonic numbers as μ up to 1, proving unbounded K. Adam zero-damping m_t,n_t give asymptotic tail (μ/sqrtν)^(t-1), hence exact μ<sqrtν condition for ν in (0,1).
